title: Sing That Ol' Fade Spiritual
description: Sing That Ol' Fade Spiritual — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Soldier Mutantos

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Slay 27 Shadow Fade Crooners and 8 Famous Shadow Fade Crooners in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Soldier Mutantos

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Algor's Terror Dome (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Slay 27 Shadow Fade Crooners and 8 Famous Shadow Fade Crooners in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and Return to Ex-Soldier Bubba in Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Offer:

Has your hearing returned yet? Good, I was getting worried about you but I see that your hearing has returned to normal. You are one tough cookie, Dungeon Runner, I will give you that. A real tough sugar cookie with rainbow colored sprinkles that is still nice, soft, and warm in the middle. Are you ready to head back into the Fade Factories to wipe those abominations from this dimension?

Head back into the Fade Factories located in the branches off of Lower Algor's Terror-Dome and slay more Shadow Fade Crooners and Famous Shadow Fade Crooners before their numbers get any higher and they inspire the workers. When you have done this return to me, Ex-Soldier Bubba, here in the Algor's Terror-Dome Base Camp.

Turn-in:

(You can't hear a word that Ex-Soldier Bubba is saying but he is nodding his head and giving you thumbs up. He then makes a motion that can only be interpreted as 'come back when your hearing returns and/or when your ears stop bleeding and you are ready to do this quest again.')

Objectives:

  • Slain Shadow Fade Crooners
  • Slain Famous Shadow Fade Crooners

Level range: 20–30
